خَضْبٌ The colour of a tree, or of the spadix of a palm-tree, when it becomes green: pl. خُضُوبٌ. (K.) ―
-b2- A plant fresh, or new, and green in consequence of rain; as also ↓ خَضُوبٌ : (K:) or watered by rain, and imparting a colour to the ordure: (TA:) or the green colour that appears in trees when they begin to put forth their leaves: (K:) pl. خُضُوبٌ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
